        violations: list[Json] = []
        events = []
        for line in lines:
            if re.search('\\b(?:chdir|fchdir)\\(', line):
                violations.append({'line': line, 'reason': 'cwd changed inside extraction trace'})
                continue
            if not re.search('\\b(?:open|openat|openat2)\\(', line):
                continue
            call = re.search('\\b(open|openat|openat2)\\((.*)\\)\\s+=\\s+(.+)$', line)
            if call is None:
                violations.append({'line': line, 'reason': 'unparsed open syscall'})

            name, arguments, result = call.groups()
            request = re.search('"((?:[^"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)"', arguments)
            if request is None:

            try:

            except (ValueError, SyntaxError):
                violations.append({'line': line, 'reason': 'invalid quoted path'})
                continue
            success = re.match('\\d+(?:<.*>)?(?:\\s|$)', result) is not None
            if not path.startswith('/'):
                directory = re.search('^[^,]*<(/[^>]*)>', arguments) if name != 'open' else None
                if directory is not None:
